name: Ari Vale
story: Ari is a quiet young courier who knows the old streets. On the night the moon disappears, Ari finds a sealed letter in their satchel and follows blue memories to uncover what happened.

appearance.face: warm medium-brown skin and simple dark eyes
appearance.outfit: teal explorer jacket, coral-red scarf, charcoal trousers, dark boots
appearance.signature_item: small navy courier satchel and a cyan memory lantern
appearance.silhouette: large square head, compact torso, clearly separated block arms and legs

goal_chapter_1: Collect three blue memory fragments and discover the voice that remembers the moon.

controls.move: Drag the on-screen joystick on the left
controls.interact: Tap INTERACT while close to a cyan memory
controls.clues: Tap JOURNAL to read collected clues
